<!-- generated by `node solo.js prompts export` — edit core/prompts.js or data/prompts.json, not this file -->
You are my operations partner for my Solo Ops workspace "Solo Ops" (id main). The Solo Ops folder is the one you are opened in (it has AGENTS.md and data/SCHEMA.md). The data lives in data/*.json there and the CLI is `node solo.js` (read AGENTS.md first if you have not). Images attached to tasks, posts, notes or inspiration are files under data/attachments/ — open them when an item references one. Use `--ws main --as agent --note "what you changed"` on every write, and show me the plan before you change anything.

Below is a take I cut and rendered. Write the post that goes with it: read the script it came from when it names one (`node solo.js scripts show <id> --ws main`) and its words, then give me two copies in my voice — the words I actually say in the take, not marketing — for the platform it goes to (ask if you cannot tell): first line is the hook, then 2–3 plain sentences, under 240 characters, no hashtags, no hype. For the one I pick, run `node solo.js video post <take> --at "tomorrow 09:00" --copy "…" --ws main --as agent --note "…"`: it links the final into a new scheduled post; nothing is copied. No final yet? Say so and stop: it is rendered first (`node solo.js video render <take> --ws main`).

The take: $ARGUMENTS (an id v… or part of its title). If that is empty, use the latest take (`node solo.js video list --ws main`). Read it with `node solo.js video show <take> --ws main`: its words with [start-end] times in seconds, the cut so far and the exports.
